name: G1
summary: Galbot G1 is a humanoid robot from Galbot. Galbot states it operates in its Galaxy Space Capsule retail units at more than 170 sites in over 40 cities in China.
specs_note: Commercial maturity COMMERCIAL recorded 2026-10-04 (owner decision, six-robot review). Basis: external deployments stated by the manufacturer and a public purchase link. Selected specifications retrieved from first-party manufacturer documentation on 2026-10-22 under HO-DATA-02B. Evidence status: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH; not human-verified. Remaining specifications are unknown unless separately documented. use_case_fits.notes: Galbot states that G1 operates in its Galaxy Space Capsule retail units at more than 170 sites in over 40 cities in China.
use_case_fits.limitations: Stated by the maker; no deployment row is recorded. Recorded for Galbot's own retail units in China only: operation in a third-party store or outside China is not recorded.

spec_caveats.text: Galbot states '机身重量 92.5 kg' (body weight); whether the battery is included is not stated.
Galbot states '负载能力（腕部中心）单臂 5 kg / 合计 10 kg': 5 kg per arm at the wrist centre, 10 kg for both arms combined. The per-arm figure is recorded.
Galbot states '自由度（不含底盘和末端执行器）合计 21': 21 DoF excluding the chassis and end effectors (neck 2, arms 7×2, waist 3, legs 2).
Galbot states '工作时长 8 小时' under the heading '续航与充电' (battery endurance and charging), next to '适配器充电 3.5 小时'; the duty cycle is not stated. 480 min is a unit conversion.
Galbot states '底盘形式 4 轮全向移动底盘' (https://www.galbot.com/g1).
Galbot states '头部 双目相机 ×1' (https://www.galbot.com/g1).
Galbot states '对话自然流畅，动作精准配合' (https://www.galbot.com/g1).
Galbot states '快速准确地完成取货与交付' / '单臂 5 kg' (https://www.galbot.com/g1).
